title: Implement the protected navigation shell with fail-closed browser proof
verify: FT-007-AC-001: every protected page receives one server-aware hamburger shell with exact Home, Classes, Statistics, Profile, and Logout controls; public and unauthenticated pages receive no protected actor data.
The Logout control submits to the existing POST /auth/logout path, which revokes the server session, clears the cookie, redirects to /login, and denies the captured old token.

The task-owned disposable runner accepts only project tmp/*.db, starts an owned server with explicit DATABASE_URL, rejects server reuse and study-calendar.db, prepares the parent, and cleans the exact database after success or failure.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-001 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: protected pages lack the common shell or a required control, client state determines visibility, logout leaves the session usable, or focused browser proof can reuse a server/real database; GREEN: route and owned-server disposable browser tests prove the five controls, server logout, old-token denial, path rejection/preparation, and success/failure cleanup; artifact: .tasks/TASK-079-T3-FT-007-W28/ and .protocols/TASK-079-T3-FT-007-W28/.
purpose: Create the reusable protected shell and keep all runner/E2E proof needed for its complete navigation/logout outcome with that implementation.
success_outcome: Protected pages share one server-authoritative navigation shell whose logout closes the session and whose browser proof cannot touch the real database.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement the existing logout route or session lifecycle.
Do not implement Home, Classes, Statistics, or Profile page behavior in the layout.
Do not change the ordinary real-database Playwright smoke.
constraints: The layout is a transport/presentation adapter over request-local server actor context.
Logout behavior stays on the existing POST /auth/logout owner and is proved as integration delta, not reimplemented.
Focused browser state is disposable and ordinary npm run e2e behavior remains unchanged.
invariants: No client-supplied role or scope controls shell visibility.
The old session cannot authorize a protected request after logout.
A focused browser gate owns one server and one tmp database and never opens or removes study-calendar.db.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-001: protected-page shell/control matrix, server-resolved visibility, logout closure, and task-local disposable proof.

stop_conditions: Stop if shell or logout requires a new session, role, authorization, or route contract.
Stop if focused proof cannot guarantee owned-server isolation and exact disposable cleanup.
